# `aitbc node island island-info`

Get detailed information for an island.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc node island island-info [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--island-id` | text | — | yes | The Island id. |
| `--node-url` | text | `http://127.0.0.1:8202` | no | Local node RPC URL <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc node island island-info --island-id <island_id>
```
